scenes.title: Translate an address into a location
Move the head and rotate the sector

vo.text: Open a file on a hard drive.
vo.speak: Open a file on a hard drive.

vo.text: The drive must find where its data is stored.
vo.speak: The drive must find where its data is stored.

vo.text: Inside, circular platters spin at a steady speed.
vo.speak: Inside, circular platters spin at a steady speed.

vo.text: Tiny magnetic regions on their surfaces represent the bits.
vo.speak: Tiny magnetic regions on their surfaces represent the bits.

vo.text: The file system gives the drive a logical address for the requested data.
vo.speak: The file system gives the drive a logical address for the requested data.

vo.text: The controller translates that address into a track and sector on the platter.
vo.speak: The controller translates that address into a track and sector on the platter.

vo.text: An actuator swings the read and write head to the correct track.
vo.speak: An actuator swings the read and write head to the correct track.

vo.text: The head waits briefly for the correct sector to rotate underneath.
vo.speak: The head waits briefly for the correct sector to rotate underneath.

vo.text: As the magnetic regions pass, the head senses their changes and the electronics retrieve the bits.
vo.speak: As the magnetic regions pass, the head senses their changes and the electronics retrieve the bits.

vo.text: A quick movement of the arm, plus the spinning platter, brings the stored data to the head.
